_comment: Offline Mendix Marketplace catalog. Served by the backend when mxcli has no authenticated session. Refresh with bin/refresh-marketplace-catalog while logged in (mxcli auth login) to replace this seed with the full live catalog including real content ids.

items.name: OQLModule
items.summary: Execute OQL queries from a microflow. Snippet to test & export OQL queries, add parameters with actions, execute query returning entities, execute query & return a CSV, etc.

items.name: Community Commons

items.name: Nanoflow Commons
items.summary: Generic useful nanoflow actions: geolocation, device info, clipboard, and client-side utilities.

items.name: Native Mobile Resources

items.name: Data Widgets
